heads.en: What a Bishop Ought to Carry Out

headnotes.la: …ae Caesaris sunt Caesari, et Deo quae Dei sunt reddere [n: (Matth. XXII, 21)]. Quia sicut sanctus Gelasius facundissimus papa in decretis suis scribens ad Anastasium imperatorem dicit [n: (epist. 10)]
headnotes.en: …e Caesar's to Caesar, and the things that are God's to God [n: (Matth. XXII, 21)]. For as St. Gelasius, that most eloquent pope, says in his decrees, writing to the emperor Anastasius [n: (epist. 10)]

headnotes.la: …ecularibus implicatus. Sanctus namque Spiritus per eos qui cum Christo in coelo regnant, et in terris miraculis coruscant, dixit, et usque ad nos scriptis pervenire fecit dicens [n: (Urban. epist. 1)]
headnotes.en: …ular business. For the Holy Spirit spoke through those who reign with Christ in heaven and flash with miracles on earth, and caused it to come down even to us in writing, saying [n: (Urban. epist. 1)]

headnotes.la: Sanctus quoque Anacletus papa, ab ipso beato Petro apostolo presbyter ordinatus, postea in sede Romana successor illius factus episcopus, cum totius mundi sacerdotibus judicavit [n: (epist. 1)]
headnotes.en: …pope who was ordained priest by the blessed Apostle Peter himself, and afterwards was made bishop as his successor in the Roman see, judged together with the priests of the whole world [n: (epist. 1)]

headnotes.la: Item sanctus Urbanus papa et martyr [n: (epist. 1)]
headnotes.en: Likewise St. Urban, pope and martyr [n: (epist. 1)]

headnotes.la: Et sanctus Gregorius in epistola ad Sabinum subdiaconum [n: (lib. VIII, epist. 7)]
headnotes.en: And St. Gregory, in his letter to the subdeacon Sabinus [n: (lib. VIII, epist. 7)]

headnotes.la: Et S. Augustinus in sermone Evangelii sancti Joannis dicit
headnotes.en: And St. Augustine, in a sermon on the Gospel of St. John, says

headnotes.la: Et item in sacris canonibus, sancto Spiritu dictatis, et Christi sanguine confirmatis, scriptum est [n: (conc. Tol. I, can. 11)]
headnotes.en: And likewise in the sacred canons, dictated by the Holy Spirit and confirmed by the blood of Christ, it is written [n: (conc. Tol. I, can. 11)]

headnotes.la: Et item scriptum est [n: (conc. Agath., can. 4)]
headnotes.en: And likewise it is written [n: (conc. Agath., can. 4)]

headnotes.la: … Dicunt enim illi, qui in coelo regnant, et in terra miraculis coruscant, qui et usque hodie nobiscum vivunt, et cum successoribus nostris usque in perpetuum vivent, quoniam apud Deum est merces eorum
headnotes.en: …X, 16)]*. For they say — they who reign in heaven and flash with miracles on earth, who both live with us to this day and shall live with our successors unto perpetuity, since their reward is with God

headnotes.la: …edidit, et apostolicae sedis atque auctoritate sua confirmavit, et per omnes metropolitanas ecclesias imperii sui perpetuo servanda direxit. Memorata itaque capitula ita se habent [n: (lib. I, c. 83)]
headnotes.en: …uthority of the apostolic see and by his own, and sent it to be observed perpetually throughout all the metropolitan churches of his empire. The chapters mentioned, then, run thus [n: (lib. I, c. 83)]

headnotes.la: Et in eodem edicto unde haec fuerunt assumpta subsequitur
headnotes.en: And in the same edict, from which these things were taken, there follows

headnotes.la: et caetera quae sequuntur. Et in privilegio Belvacensis Ecclesiae, ab episcopis quatuor provinciarum consensu domni Caroli nuper defuncti confirmato, haec continetur ad locum
headnotes.en: …t that follows. And in the privilege of the Church of Beauvais, confirmed by the bishops of four provinces with the consent of the lord Charles lately deceased, this is contained in the relevant place

headnotes.la: Et in privilegio ejusdem Ecclesiae a domno Nicolao papa confirmato haec continentur ad locum [n: (Nicolaus Odon. episc. )]
headnotes.en: And in the privilege of the same Church, confirmed by the lord Pope Nicholas, these things are contained in the relevant place [n: (Nicolaus Odon. episc. )]

headnotes.la: Et sanctus Gregorius in decretali epistola, in partes Graeciae pro quibusdam commotionibus directa, ita dicit ad locum
headnotes.en: And St. Gregory, in a decretal letter sent into the regions of Greece on account of certain disturbances, speaks thus in the relevant place
